additional_info.subject: ID0477750-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / P1 170000111] Modbus is not connected CRM:03289000525
additional_info.body:
Dear Bjoern,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, we have looked into the logs in the given timestamps, and find that these errors appear during the charging sessions.
In the attached logs you can see that the communication between the car and the charger was lost, and that this caused the errors to appear.
We also see that a few minutes after the charger resolved these errors automatically. All these errors are a reaction on the communication being lost, or the network being lost.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Please provide us with feedback, so we can close the ticket.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: ID0477750-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / P1 170000111] Modbus is not connected CRM:03289000525
additional_info.body:
Dear Bjoern,
Thank you for your email back.
Following you request, we have checked multiple charging sessions from January until now. We see that all these errors are an reaction to the network connectivity, and the communication being lost between the car and the charger. See attached screenshots for reference. When the Ecog of the charger is trying to reconnect, the charger receives a lot of communication logs trough out the charging sessions, this means that although there are a lot of error logs, in this case it is normal as these are communication logs of the charger trying to reconnect.
We will monitor the charger for the next three days, to see if any of these errors appear again in the coming three days, and to see if the cause of the errors are the same.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
